description.narrative: Funsani-projektet (Fråga!) har som mål att upprätthålla ett öppet demokratiskt utrymme för media, civilsamhället och medborgarna i syfte att öka transparens och ansvarsutkrävande. Detta åstadkoms genom att stärka kapaciteten hos, och förbättra regelverken för, mediasektorn, samt driva på medborgarnas engagemang och deltagande (i samhällsstyrning) med fokus på kvinnor och ungdomar.

The Funsani 'Ask' Project aims to keep the democratic space open for the media, civil society and citizens in order to improve transparency and accountability. This will be done through strengthening the capacity and regulatory environment of the media sector and facilitating citizen engagement and participation (in governance issues) with a focus on women and youth.

The overall objective/impact is that:
Civic space in Zambia is held open by media, CSOs and citizens, facilitating improved accountability and transparency.
BBC MA proposes three Outcomes as follows:
1. Media outlets in Zambia have the technical skills, networks and financial resources to produce public interest content which enables Zambians to hold their leaders accountable.
2. Zambian citizens, particularly youth, are more informed, motivated and civically engaged.
3. The financial, legal, (self-) regulatory and political operating context in Zambia supports the production of public interest media.
